IBM is outlining a 1,040‑qubit modular architecture aimed at achieving fault‑tolerant quantum computing. The roadmap details a hierarchical layout of many small superconducting modules connected via photonic links to build a large, coherent system that supports quantum error correction. This initiative represents a significant step toward scalable, practical quantum computation.
